notes: IMPORTANT: This site uses JavaScript to dynamically load listings into empty div.fl-html containers. A basic HTTP scraper cannot access the content. REQUIRES Playwright/Selenium for JavaScript rendering. The listings appear to be embedded from a third-party service (possibly an IDX feed or similar). Main listing pages: 1) For Sale: https://cscpok.com/search-properties-copy-copy/ 2) For Lease: https://cscpok.com/search-properties-copy/ 3) Combined: https://cscpok.com/search-properties/ All three pages show the same pattern of empty fl-module-html/fl-html containers that need JS to populate. Site is built on WordPress with Beaver Builder page builder. Next steps: Use Playwright/Puppeteer to render JavaScript, wait for dynamic content to load, then inspect the actual DOM structure to identify proper selectors for title, price, location, etc.
